text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Two people die near Camp Doha after their speeding vehicle hit cement fortifications around the camp, a warehouse complex used by the United States military to pre-position weapons.
- Interior Minister Sheikh Mohammad Khaled al-Sabah visits northern border with Iraq.
- Britain's Prince Charles to visit Kuwait on October 21 as part of Gulf tour.
- Kuwaiti Crown Prince Abdulla receives two telephone calls from President Hosni Mubarak of Egypt and Saudi Arabian Defence Minister Prince Sultan.
